capabilities: Distributed task execution and ML tools
decision: Add only when single-node profiling warrants
limitation: Fault recovery, deterministic folds and aggregation are product responsibilities
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: An immutable partitioned dataset, task graph, model artifacts and deterministic fold/seed map.
scientific_qualification.output: Distributed task results, fitted nuisance objects and reductions.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Statistical split boundaries and aggregation are invariant to scheduling, retries and worker count.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Adopt only after profiling. Tasks/actors/objects do not determine independent sampling units; retain explicit cluster/time partitioning and avoid duplicated score contributions on retry.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Kill/retry a worker during a bounded benchmark, change partition count, and require exactly-once logical contributions and equal fold membership; compare covariance with the local reference.

evidence.finding: Distributed runtime, AI libraries and task/actor/object abstractions.
